zh: 登录页右上角新增浅色/深色主题切换功能，支持一键切换昼夜色调，实时跟随系统偏好与跨页面持久化存储。
移动端全面支持对话列表置顶功能：支持长按会话或点击操作菜单快速置顶/取消置顶，置顶会话常驻列表顶部专区并展示置顶标识，与 Web 端及桌面端会话偏好实时双向云同步。
优化移动端多图片堆交互体验：全面重构 iOS 与 Android 卡片滑动手势与离场物理动效，卡片划走平滑飞出并伴随触感震动反馈。
en: Add light and dark theme toggle to the login page top bar, supporting one-click day/night switching with cross-page persistence.
Add conversation pinning to mobile apps: support long-press context menu and action button to pin/unpin conversations to the top, fully synchronized in real-time with Web and Desktop clients.
Optimize multi-image card stack interaction on iOS and Android: overhauled swipe-away physics and smooth exit transitions with subtle haptic feedback.
